_comment: One standout 'player to watch' per team for the 2026 tournament, chosen by profile/popularity. 'reason' is a short why-watch note. 'image_url' is intentionally EMPTY - do NOT scrape or hotlink Google Images (copyright + broken links). Fill image_url only with a properly licensed image you have rights to (or leave empty to render the flag+initials avatar fallback). Keys use English team names; adapt to your team records / Zafronix names.

Mexico.reason: Prolific striker and the focal point of Mexico's attack as co-hosts.

Canada.reason: Bayern Munich flyer and Canada's biggest star at a home World Cup.

United States.reason: The face of the USMNT and its creative talisman on home soil.

Argentina.reason: The reigning champions' icon, likely playing his final World Cup.

Brazil.reason: Real Madrid superstar leading Brazil's attack under Ancelotti.

Colombia.reason: Explosive winger and Colombia's main attacking threat.

Paraguay.reason: Skilful young forward and Paraguay's spark in attack.

Uruguay.reason: Tireless, all-action Real Madrid midfielder driving Bielsa's side.

Curacao.reason: Their most recognizable name with top-European experience.

Haiti.reason: Powerful striker leading the line for a historic Haiti squad.

New Zealand.reason: Premier League striker and New Zealand's talisman.

Austria.reason: Real Madrid veteran and Austria's leader at the back.

Belgium.reason: World-class playmaker and Belgium's chief creator.

Bosnia and Herzegovina.reason: Legendary striker still leading the line for Bosnia.

Croatia.reason: Ballon d'Or winner orchestrating Croatia's midfield once more.

Czechia.reason: Clinical Bayer Leverkusen striker and Czechia's goal threat.

England.reason: Real Madrid star and the heartbeat of England's midfield.

France.reason: Captain, superstar, and France's decisive attacking force.

Germany.reason: Dazzling playmaker and the creative hub of Nagelsmann's Germany.

Netherlands.reason: Commanding captain and one of the world's best defenders.

Norway.reason: Goal machine making his long-awaited World Cup debut.

Portugal.reason: All-time great in a likely final World Cup appearance.

Scotland.reason: Napoli midfielder and Scotland's driving force.

Spain.reason: Teenage Barcelona phenomenon and Spain's most exciting talent.

Switzerland.reason: Experienced captain and midfield general for Switzerland.

Turkiye.reason: Gifted Real Madrid playmaker and Turkiye's rising star.

Algeria.reason: Skilful winger and Algeria's biggest attacking name.

Cape Verde.reason: Experienced forward leading a historic Cape Verde debut.

Cote d'Ivoire.reason: Powerful striker and Ivory Coast's main goal threat.

DR Congo.reason: Sharp Premier League forward leading DR Congo's attack.

Egypt.reason: Liverpool icon and Egypt's all-time talisman.

Ghana.reason: Dynamic attacker and Ghana's standout creative force.

Morocco.reason: Elite attacking full-back from Morocco's semifinal generation.

Senegal.reason: Quick, modern striker leading Senegal's front line.

South Africa.reason: Premier League forward and South Africa's main striker.

Tunisia.reason: Energetic midfielder and one of Tunisia's brightest talents.

Australia.reason: Captain and midfield leader for the Socceroos.

Iraq.reason: Reliable striker and Iraq's main goal threat.

Iran.reason: Clinical striker and Iran's standout attacker.

Japan.reason: Skilful Real Sociedad attacker and Japan's creative star.

Jordan.reason: Pacey winger leading Jordan's first-ever World Cup squad.

Qatar.reason: Asian Cup star and Qatar's main attacking talent.

Saudi Arabia.reason: Match-winning winger and Saudi Arabia's talisman.

South Korea.reason: Captain, global star, and South Korea's iconic forward.

Uzbekistan.reason: Highly-rated young defender on Uzbekistan's historic debut.
